# Score

## Summary
A 1–5 star rating with an explicit unset state. Renders stars in every format: edit is a clickable star row (with a small pop on select), embedded shows the full five-star readout with `n/5`, atom compresses to `★ n` for dense rows. An explicit 0 renders as a number; only null/undefined renders as the em-dash "not scored" — so an unrated criterion never reads as a zero.

## Usage
```ts
import { ScoreField } from './score-field';

@field interviewScore = contains(ScoreField);
```
Consumed in the shared realm by App 2's Meeting (`interviewScore`), Candidate (`overallScore`) and the Scorecard compound field (per-criterion `score`). The linked example is an interview Meeting whose scorecard carries three scored criteria. Primitive (NumberField-based) field — inline `containedExamples` unsupported in base; the in-use instance stands in.

## Non-goals
The scale is fixed at 5 — a configurable-max variant is a deliberate non-feature until a real consumer needs one (a 10-point scale reads as a different UI, not a longer star row). Aggregation (average of criteria) belongs to the consumer's computed field, not the display block. Free-form sentiment (mood emoji) is a different concept and stays out.
